description: Single source of truth for the lifecycle smoke test (tests/smoke/test_skill_crud_lifecycle.py, Phase CL Steps 115 and 116). It names the synthetic portable skill that test CREATEs, READs and UPDATEs inside a disposable Git copy of the catalog, the exact canonical bytes it authors, and the inputs of the destructive transitions (RENAME and DELETE) run against it. Nothing here is ever written into this checkout: the skill exists only in a temporary synthetic repository, its builds and its disposable homes.
